acceptance: DECISIONS A22: CCGT hot/warm/cold restart GBP 110/130/150 per MW chosen by the expected downtime H (< 12 h hot, 12-48 h warm, > 48 h cold); OCGT GBP 170 per MW (wear plus start-up fuel and carbon, the same basis as the other technologies); biomass GBP 125 per MW; minimum stable generation CCGT 50 %, OCGT 50 %, biomass 35 %; minimum down time 6 h / 0.5 h / 6 h. H = (number of consecutive surplus periods of the day-ahead forecast from the current period) x 0.5 h; a unit may enter the shutdown segment only when H >= its minimum down time.
applies_to: value-corrected profile only (correction r12.economic-downward-order, decisions A19 and A22). The doctoral profile keeps the thesis curtail-cost order (Q1).
compiled_from: docs/dev/REFERENCE_STATISTICS_FOR_AUTHOR_REVIEW.md section 4 (unit R1-1; values 4.5, conversion 4.2, per-MWh comparison 4.6)
price_basis: 2024 GBP per MW of capacity per start: wear (Kumar et al. 2012 median, lower bound) plus start-up fuel and carbon (Staffell & Green 2015, GB), converted with Bank of England annual exchange rates and the ONS CPI (reference statistics 4.2). The model's money is constant base-year GBP undiscounted (Q4/P4-02); its base year follows each asset's cost source.

rule.running_range: Output above min_stable_fraction x the asset's online capacity is reduced without a restart: its cost of reduction is minus the avoided short-run cost c (fuel + carbon + unit_time_cost (VOM) + base, i.e. gen_cost), so it is always cheaper than curtailing VRE (cost 0).
rule.online_capacity: The aggregate fleet has no commitment state; its online capacity in a period is its accepted day-ahead output of that period (units scheduled day-ahead are online and fully loaded).
rule.shutdown_segment: Output below min_stable_fraction x online capacity (down to the ramp floor) needs units to shut down and restart later at S per MW: net saving per MWh a(H) = c - S(H) / H. a > 0: reduced before VRE (in descending a); a <= 0: after VRE; H < min_down_time_h: not allowed while any other down regulation is left (last resort).

CCGT.asset_match: GasGenerator whose name does not contain OCGT
CCGT.grades: restart: R1 wear 31/49/71 [E] + R3 fuel and carbon 80 [E]; min stable: R4/R5 45 %, R6 50 %, Elexon SEL/MEL 47-60 % [V]; min down: Elexon MZT 360 min [V] (literature 1-2 h)

OCGT.grades: restart: R1 wear 29 [E] + R3 fuel and carbon 140 [E] (warm/cold [NV], equal to hot); min stable: R6 50 % [E] (R5 20 %, one Elexon unit 90 %); min down: one period (Elexon MZT 20 min [V], R5 0)
